## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the behavior or documentation this changes. Link an issue if applicable.

## Scope and compatibility

Identify affected policies, owners, contracts, consumers or examples. Explain material departures and proposals separately from already accepted decisions.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. State what was not run and why. Distinguish observed behavior, simulations and structural checks. For documentation-only changes, report relevant link/consistency checks.

## Remaining concerns

Record unresolved questions, known limitations or follow-up work. Do not include private data or credentials.
